hookLine: Console wars never end. Let's rank the craziest ads from PlayStation and Xbox.

items.voiceLine: PlayStation once ran an ad that was just a newborn baby with a voiceover about the miracle of life... to sell a game console. Bizarre, unsettling, nobody asked for this. D-Tier, an all-time head-scratcher.
Then there's the PS2 ad that got banned in multiple countries for being straight-up disturbing. Bold creative choice, terrible execution. C-Tier, style over sense.
Xbox's 'Life is Short. Play More.' ad walks through an entire lifetime in sixty seconds just to say go play games. Emotional, well shot, genuinely moving. A-Tier, they made you cry for a console ad.

But Halo 3's 'Believe' campaign built an entire fake war memorial and museum just to hype one video game. Cinematic, massive budget, treated like a real historical event. S-Tier, advertising on a completely different level.

outroLine: PlayStation or Xbox? Drop your pick and subscribe!
